training_data: supplied listings_clean.csv.zip, 150000 labelled sales through May 2026
protocol: official expanding sale-month validation; each fold trains on sales before that month

feature_parity.checks: exact DataFrame equality, including values, index, column order, and dtypes

off_market.current_equivalence: same estimator settings and exact same row-local feature tables on all training/test rows; off-market folds were not rerun after moving the builder

list_aware.evaluation: fresh six-month evaluation of the current sources and uploaded Joey feature specification

limits: Hidden test sold prices are unavailable; no hidden-test accuracy or rank claim.
Input cleaning provenance was not independently verified; uses supplied cleaned CSVs.
Repeatedly consulted validation periods should not be presented as untouched holdout data.
Existing submission CSVs were preserved rather than regenerated during this feature task.
